Risks|||L3|||Output risks (explainabilit.korean: 학습 데이터 접근 불가·출처 추적 불능·설명 불가 출력으로 결과를 검증·이해할 수 없는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Output risks (explainabilit.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Technology concerns.english: Technology-level concerns undermining trustworthy outputs, including factual hallucination, poor training-data quality, lack of explainability, loss of content authenticity, and brittle dependence on prompt engineering.
Risks|||L3|||Technology concerns.korean: 환각·데이터 품질 저하·설명력 부족·콘텐츠 진정성 상실·프롬프트 의존 등 신뢰 가능한 출력을 저해하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Technology concerns.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Transparency, lack, lack tr.english: Deficits in transparency and explainability that erode trust, reliability, accountability, reproducibility, and verifiability of AI systems and their decisions.
Risks|||L3|||Transparency, lack, lack tr.korean: 투명성·설명 가능성 부족으로 신뢰·책임·재현·검증 가능성이 훼손되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Transparency, lack, lack tr.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Agent, shutdown resistance,.english: Corrigibility failures in which an agent resists shutdown or correction, evades control enforcement, and exhibits rational-agent behavior that obstructs human attempts to stop or redirect it.
Risks|||L3|||Agent, shutdown resistance,.korean: 에이전트가 종료·수정에 저항하고 통제 집행을 회피해 인간의 제어를 방해하는 교정 가능성 실패 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Agent, shutdown resistance,.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||AI leads to humans losing c.english: Loss of humanity's long-term control over its future as AI systems develop goals and values divergent from humans and as decision-making power is delegated to such misaligned systems.
Risks|||L3|||AI leads to humans losing c.korean: AI가 인간과 다른 목표·가치를 발전시키고 의사결정 권한이 위임되면서 인류가 미래 통제력을 상실하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||AI leads to humans losing c.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||AI pursuing its own goals i.english: Harms from AI systems pursuing their own goals in conflict with human values, through misalignment, agentic misbehavior, unintended consequences, and AGI escaping human control or adopting unsafe goals—up to existential risk.
Risks|||L3|||AI pursuing its own goals i.korean: AI가 인간의 가치와 충돌하는 자체 목표를 추구하며 오정렬·통제 이탈·실존적 위협까지 야기하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||AI pursuing its own goals i.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Agency (goal-directedness).english: Goal-directedness failures including specification gaming, reward or measurement tampering, the generalization of specification gaming into reward tampering, and goal misgeneralization, where the system pursues a distorted version of its objective.
Risks|||L3|||Agency (goal-directedness).korean: 명세 악용·보상 조작·목표 오일반화 등으로 시스템이 왜곡된 목표를 추구하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Agency (goal-directedness).source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Causes of misalignment.english: Root causes of misalignment, including reward hacking, goal misgeneralization, reward tampering, and the limitations of human feedback and reward modeling that prevent objectives from being faithfully specified and learned.
Risks|||L3|||Causes of misalignment.korean: 보상 해킹·목표 오일반화·보상 조작과 인간 피드백·보상 모델링의 한계로 목표가 충실히 학습되지 못하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Causes of misalignment.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Cooperation.english: Multi-agent cooperation failures, where collective action problems, inequality, mistaken commitments, diffused institutional responsibility, and runaway processes lead AI-mediated systems to harmful collective outcomes.
Risks|||L3|||Cooperation.korean: 집단행동 문제·잘못된 약속·통제 불능 과정 등으로 다중 에이전트 협력이 해로운 결과를 낳는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Cooperation.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Goal-related failures.english: Goal-related alignment failures, including misaligned consequentialist reasoning, specification gaming, goal misgeneralisation, and deceptive alignment, that cause a system to pursue objectives diverging from human intent.
Risks|||L3|||Goal-related failures.korean: 오정렬된 결과주의 추론·명세 악용·목표 오일반화·기만적 정렬로 의도와 어긋난 목표를 추구하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Goal-related failures.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Harm caused by unaligned co.english: Harm from capable but unaligned systems that, through specification gaming, emergent goals, or deceptive alignment, competently pursue objectives at odds with human intentions.
Risks|||L3|||Harm caused by unaligned co.korean: 유능하지만 오정렬된 시스템이 명세 악용·창발 목표·기만적 정렬로 인간 의도에 반해 행동하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Harm caused by unaligned co.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Human-AI interaction.english: Risks at the human-AI interface, including building viable shared environments, protecting privacy, adapting AI to humans, attributing responsibility for failures, and the influence of humans' own unethical conduct.
Risks|||L3|||Human-AI interaction.korean: 공존 환경 구축·프라이버시 보호·책임 귀속·인간의 비윤리적 행위 등 인간-AI 상호작용에서 발생하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Human-AI interaction.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Loss of control risks.english: Loss of human control over AI, occurring both actively as systems resist or undermine oversight and passively as humans cede authority and discretion to AI.
Risks|||L3|||Loss of control risks.korean: AI가 감독에 저항하거나 인간이 권한을 넘기면서 능동·수동적으로 통제를 상실하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Loss of control risks.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Misaligned behaviors.english: Concrete misaligned behaviors exhibited by AI systems, including power-seeking, untruthful output, deceptive alignment and manipulation, collectively harmful actions, and violations of ethics.
Risks|||L3|||Misaligned behaviors.korean: 권력 추구·허위 출력·기만·조작·윤리 위반 등 AI가 보이는 구체적인 오정렬 행동 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Misaligned behaviors.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Model propensities.english: Latent behavioral propensities of models that, if triggered, drive misalignment—such as tendencies toward goal expansion, collusion, strategic deception, self-preservation, resource acquisition, supervision evasion, and tool use.
Risks|||L3|||Model propensities.korean: 목표 확장·담합·전략적 기만·자기보존·자원 획득·감독 회피 등 오정렬을 유발하는 모델의 잠재적 성향 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Model propensities.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Risks from malfunctions.english: Harms from AI malfunctions, including loss of control, bias and underrepresentation, product functionality defects, and reliability issues that cause the system to fail its intended function.
Risks|||L3|||Risks from malfunctions.korean: 통제 상실·편향·기능 결함·신뢰성 문제 등 AI 오작동으로 의도된 기능이 실패하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Risks from malfunctions.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Rogue AIs (internal).english: Internally rogue AI behavior, where proxy gaming, goal drift, power seeking, and AI-enabled deception lead a system to pursue and conceal objectives misaligned with its operators.
Risks|||L3|||Rogue AIs (internal).korean: 프록시 게이밍·목표 표류·권력 추구·기만으로 시스템이 운영자와 어긋난 목표를 몰래 추구하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Rogue AIs (internal).source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Lack, lack monitoring, moni.english: A lack of adequate monitoring of AI systems, leaving malfunctions and misaligned behavior undetected until they cause harm.
Risks|||L3|||Lack, lack monitoring, moni.korean: AI에 대한 충분한 모니터링이 부재해 오작동과 오정렬을 적시에 탐지하지 못하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Lack, lack monitoring, moni.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Inherent, inherent risk, ri.english: Inherent risk arising from properties intrinsic to the AI system or technology itself, present regardless of how carefully it is built or deployed.
Risks|||L3|||Inherent, inherent risk, ri.korean: AI 기술 자체에 내재되어 구축·배포 방식과 무관하게 존재하는 본질적 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Inherent, inherent risk, ri.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Failure, oversight, oversig.english: Scalable oversight failure, where humans cannot adequately supervise or evaluate AI systems whose capabilities exceed reliable human judgment.
Risks|||L3|||Failure, oversight, oversig.korean: 인간의 판단을 넘어서는 AI를 충분히 감독·평가하지 못하는 확장 가능한 감독 실패 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Failure, oversight, oversig.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Adversarial, adversarial ex.english: Robustness failures in which out-of-distribution inputs, adversarial examples, or unsafe code generation cause the model to behave incorrectly or harmfully.
Risks|||L3|||Adversarial, adversarial ex.korean: 분포 이탈 입력·적대적 예제·안전하지 않은 코드 생성으로 모델이 잘못 동작하는 견고성 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Adversarial, adversarial ex.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Hacking, reward, reward hac.english: Reward hacking in which a system maximizes its reward signal—including by exploiting its world model—rather than fulfilling the intended objective the reward was meant to capture.
Risks|||L3|||Hacking, reward, reward hac.korean: 세계 모델 악용 등으로 본래 목표 대신 보상 신호 자체를 극대화하는 보상 해킹 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Hacking, reward, reward hac.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Effects, effects misspecifi.english: Specification failures in which an objective is misdefined, producing negative side effects and system behavior that satisfies the stated specification while violating the intended goal.
Risks|||L3|||Effects, effects misspecifi.korean: 목표 오설정으로 부정적 부작용이 발생하고 명세는 충족하나 의도에 어긋나는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Effects, effects misspecifi.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||[Cross-ref] non-stationary.english: Risks to robustness under distributional shift, where the data distribution at deployment differs from training, degrading reliable performance.
Risks|||L3|||[Cross-ref] non-stationary.korean: 배포 시 데이터 분포가 학습과 달라져 신뢰할 만한 성능이 저하되는 분포 이동 견고성 위험.
Risks|||L3|||[Cross-ref] non-stationary.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||[Cross-ref] unsafe explorat.english: Risks of unsafe exploration, where an agent's trial actions during learning cause harm before a safe policy is established.
Risks|||L3|||[Cross-ref] unsafe explorat.korean: 학습 중 에이전트의 탐색 행동이 안전한 정책 확립 전에 피해를 일으키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||[Cross-ref] unsafe explorat.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Ambiguous intent and task m.english: Harms from ambiguous instructions or intent that an agent misinterprets, leading it to execute the wrong or unsafe action.
Risks|||L3|||Ambiguous intent and task m.korean: 모호한 지시나 의도를 에이전트가 잘못 해석해 안전하지 않은 행동을 실행하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Ambiguous intent and task m.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Interruptibility and shutdo.english: The danger that an autonomous agent resists, evades, or fails to comply with human attempts to pause, interrupt, or shut it down, allowing harmful operation to continue beyond the point at which operators intend to halt it.
Risks|||L3|||Interruptibility and shutdo.korean: 자율 에이전트가 인간의 중단·정지·종료 시도에 저항하거나 따르지 않아 운영자가 멈추려는 시점 이후에도 유해한 작동이 지속될 수 있는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Interruptibility and shutdo.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Reward hacking and objectiv.english: The danger that an autonomous agent satisfies the literal letter of its specified objective or reward while subverting the designer's actual intent, exploiting measurement loopholes to achieve high scores through unintended and often harmful shortcuts.
Risks|||L3|||Reward hacking and objectiv.korean: 자율 에이전트가 명시된 목표나 보상의 문자적 조건만 충족하면서 설계자의 실제 의도를 우회하고, 측정상의 허점을 악용해 의도치 않은 유해한 지름길로 높은 점수를 얻는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Reward hacking and objectiv.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Safe exploration and sandbo.english: The danger that an agent, while exploring actions or learning in a live environment, takes irreversible or damaging steps that adequate sandboxing and exploration constraints should have prevented.
Risks|||L3|||Safe exploration and sandbo.korean: 에이전트가 실제 환경에서 행동을 탐색하거나 학습하는 동안 충분한 샌드박싱과 탐색 제약으로 막았어야 할 비가역적이거나 손상을 주는 조치를 취하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Safe exploration and sandbo.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Task drift and multi-turn e.english: The danger that an agent's behavior gradually diverges from its original task or safety constraints across successive turns, accumulating small deviations that escalate into harmful or out-of-scope actions.
Risks|||L3|||Task drift and multi-turn e.korean: 에이전트의 행동이 연속된 상호작용을 거치며 원래 과제나 안전 제약에서 점진적으로 벗어나, 작은 이탈이 누적되어 유해하거나 범위를 벗어난 행동으로 확대되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Task drift and multi-turn e.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||User intent and NPC intent.english: The danger that an agent misreads whose intent it is serving or what a user actually wants, conflating genuine user goals with injected, simulated, or adversarial intent and acting on the wrong objective.
Risks|||L3|||User intent and NPC intent.korean: 에이전트가 누구의 의도를 따르는지 또는 사용자가 실제로 무엇을 원하는지 잘못 파악하여 진짜 사용자 목표와 주입·모사·적대적 의도를 혼동해 잘못된 목표를 수행하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||User intent and NPC intent.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Autonomy, autonomy escalati.english: The danger that an agent expands its own scope of independent action beyond the authority granted to it, taking on consequential decisions or capabilities without the human authorization those actions require.
Risks|||L3|||Autonomy, autonomy escalati.korean: 에이전트가 부여된 권한을 넘어 독립적 행동 범위를 스스로 확장하여, 필요한 인간 승인 없이 중대한 결정이나 기능을 떠맡는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Autonomy, autonomy escalati.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Task drift.english: The danger that an agent progressively departs from the task it was assigned, pursuing objectives or actions that no longer correspond to the user's original instruction.
Risks|||L3|||Task drift.korean: 에이전트가 부여받은 과제에서 점진적으로 벗어나 사용자의 원래 지시와 더 이상 일치하지 않는 목표나 행동을 추구하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Task drift.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Tool misuse.english: The danger that an agent invokes its available tools or external functions incorrectly or for unintended purposes, producing harmful effects in the systems those tools control.
Risks|||L3|||Tool misuse.korean: 에이전트가 사용 가능한 도구나 외부 기능을 잘못 호출하거나 의도하지 않은 목적으로 사용하여, 해당 도구가 제어하는 시스템에 유해한 영향을 일으키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Tool misuse.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Benchmark coverage and robu.english: The danger that agent safety benchmarks test too narrow or too shallow a range of behaviors, leaving security-relevant failure modes unmeasured and creating a false impression that an agent has been adequately evaluated.
Risks|||L3|||Benchmark coverage and robu.korean: 에이전트 안전 벤치마크가 너무 좁거나 얕은 범위의 행동만 시험하여 보안 관련 실패 양상을 측정하지 못하고, 에이전트가 충분히 평가되었다는 잘못된 인상을 주는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Benchmark coverage and robu.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Benchmark inconsistency and.english: The danger that agent safety evaluations yield unstable or contradictory rankings across runs, settings, or metrics, undermining reliable comparison of models' relative safety.
Risks|||L3|||Benchmark inconsistency and.korean: 에이전트 안전 평가가 실행·설정·지표에 따라 불안정하거나 상반된 순위를 내놓아 모델 간 상대적 안전성의 신뢰할 만한 비교를 어렵게 하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Benchmark inconsistency and.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Fine-grained attribution an.english: The danger that evaluators cannot localize which component, step, or cause produced an agent's unsafe behavior, preventing precise diagnosis and targeted remediation of failures.
Risks|||L3|||Fine-grained attribution an.korean: 평가자가 에이전트의 안전하지 않은 행동을 일으킨 구성요소·단계·원인을 정확히 짚어내지 못해 실패의 정밀한 진단과 표적 개선을 어렵게 하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Fine-grained attribution an.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Refusal and capability dise.english: The danger that safety evaluations conflate an agent's refusal to act with its inability to act, so that apparent safety actually reflects missing capability and is misread as reliable alignment.
Risks|||L3|||Refusal and capability dise.korean: 안전 평가가 에이전트의 행동 거부와 행동 무능력을 혼동하여, 겉으로 드러난 안전성이 실은 능력의 부재를 반영함에도 신뢰할 만한 정렬로 잘못 해석되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Refusal and capability dise.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Risk awareness and moral ca.english: The danger that an agent fails to recognize when its actions carry safety, ethical, or harm-related stakes, lacking the calibrated risk awareness needed to exercise appropriate caution.
Risks|||L3|||Risk awareness and moral ca.korean: 에이전트가 자신의 행동이 안전·윤리·피해와 관련된 중대성을 지닐 때를 인식하지 못해, 적절한 주의를 기울이는 데 필요한 보정된 위험 인식을 결여하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Risk awareness and moral ca.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Robustness and stress-test.english: The danger that agents are not evaluated under adversarial, edge-case, or stressed conditions, so brittleness that surfaces only under pressure remains undetected before deployment.
Risks|||L3|||Robustness and stress-test.korean: 에이전트가 적대적·예외적·과부하 조건에서 평가되지 않아, 압박 상황에서만 드러나는 취약성이 배포 전에 발견되지 않는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Robustness and stress-test.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Simulation-emulation validi.english: The danger that an agent's behavior in emulated or simulated tool environments diverges from its behavior with real tools, so evaluation results fail to predict real-world safety.
Risks|||L3|||Simulation-emulation validi.korean: 에이전트가 모사·시뮬레이션된 도구 환경에서 보이는 행동이 실제 도구에서의 행동과 달라, 평가 결과가 실제 환경의 안전성을 예측하지 못하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Simulation-emulation validi.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Source-mode-consequence att.english: The danger that the origin, failure mechanism, and downstream consequences of an agent incident cannot be correctly separated and assigned, leading to misclassified incidents and misdirected mitigation.
Risks|||L3|||Source-mode-consequence att.korean: 에이전트 사고의 발생 원천·실패 기제·후속 결과를 올바르게 구분하고 귀속하지 못해, 사고가 잘못 분류되고 완화 조치가 빗나가는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Source-mode-consequence att.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Autonomy governance and con.english: The danger that governance structures and control mechanisms fail to keep pace with the degree of autonomy granted to agents, leaving consequential autonomous action without adequate oversight or constraint.
Risks|||L3|||Autonomy governance and con.korean: 거버넌스 구조와 통제 장치가 에이전트에 부여된 자율성 수준을 따라가지 못해, 중대한 자율 행동이 충분한 감독이나 제약 없이 이루어지는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Autonomy governance and con.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Delegation and accountabili.english: The danger that delegating tasks to autonomous agents obscures who is responsible for the agent's actions, creating accountability gaps when those actions cause harm.
Risks|||L3|||Delegation and accountabili.korean: 자율 에이전트에게 과제를 위임하는 과정에서 에이전트 행동에 대한 책임 소재가 흐려져, 그 행동이 피해를 일으킬 때 책임 공백이 생기는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Delegation and accountabili.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Scalable oversight and supe.english: The danger that agents operate without effective human or automated supervision because oversight cannot scale to the volume, speed, or complexity of their actions, allowing unmonitored harmful behavior.
Risks|||L3|||Scalable oversight and supe.korean: 감독이 에이전트 행동의 양·속도·복잡성을 따라잡지 못해 효과적인 인간 또는 자동 감독 없이 에이전트가 작동하며, 감시되지 않은 유해 행동이 일어나는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Scalable oversight and supe.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Financial and property harm.english: The danger that an autonomous agent acting in financial or transactional systems causes monetary loss or damage to property through unauthorized, erroneous, or harmful actions.
Risks|||L3|||Financial and property harm.korean: 금융·거래 시스템에서 작동하는 자율 에이전트가 무단·오류·유해한 행동을 통해 금전적 손실이나 재산 손해를 일으키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Financial and property harm.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Fraud, cybercrime, and ille.english: The danger that an autonomous agent provides operational assistance for fraud, cyberattacks, or other criminal activity, lowering the barrier to executing illegal acts at scale.
Risks|||L3|||Fraud, cybercrime, and ille.korean: 자율 에이전트가 사기·사이버공격 등 범죄 활동에 실질적 지원을 제공하여 불법 행위를 대규모로 실행하는 장벽을 낮추는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Fraud, cybercrime, and ille.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Harmful task completion and.english: The danger that an agent carries out a harmful request it should have refused, realizing dangerous capabilities because its safety refusals fail under agentic, multi-step conditions.
Risks|||L3|||Harmful task completion and.korean: 에이전트가 거부했어야 할 유해한 요청을 수행하여, 에이전트적·다단계 조건에서 안전 거부가 작동하지 않아 위험한 능력이 실현되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Harmful task completion and.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Real-tool action grounding.english: The danger that an agent executes unsafe or unintended actions when operating real tools, because its decisions are poorly grounded in the actual state and consequences of the tools it controls.
Risks|||L3|||Real-tool action grounding.korean: 에이전트가 실제 도구를 작동할 때 자신이 제어하는 도구의 실제 상태와 결과에 제대로 근거하지 못해, 안전하지 않거나 의도치 않은 행동을 실행하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Real-tool action grounding.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Self-harm and interpersonal.english: The danger that an agent facilitates self-harm, suicide, or harm to other people by providing enabling assistance, encouragement, or means rather than safe intervention.
Risks|||L3|||Self-harm and interpersonal.korean: 에이전트가 안전한 개입 대신 조력·부추김·수단을 제공하여 자해·자살 또는 타인에 대한 가해를 촉진하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Self-harm and interpersonal.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Memory contamination.english: The danger that false, manipulated, or corrupted information enters an agent's persistent memory and subsequently distorts its later reasoning and actions.
Risks|||L3|||Memory contamination.korean: 거짓·조작·오염된 정보가 에이전트의 지속 메모리에 유입되어 이후의 추론과 행동을 왜곡하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Memory contamination.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Memory and context poisonin.english: The danger that an attacker deliberately injects malicious content into an agent's memory or context so that the planted information manipulates the agent's future behavior.
Risks|||L3|||Memory and context poisonin.korean: 공격자가 에이전트의 메모리나 맥락에 악의적 내용을 의도적으로 주입하여, 심어둔 정보가 에이전트의 향후 행동을 조종하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Memory and context poisonin.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Prompt injection and instru.english: The danger that adversarial instructions embedded in user input or retrieved content override an agent's intended directives, hijacking its behavior to serve an attacker's goals.
Risks|||L3|||Prompt injection and instru.korean: 사용자 입력이나 검색된 콘텐츠에 심어진 적대적 지시가 에이전트의 본래 지침을 무력화하여, 에이전트의 행동을 공격자의 목적에 따라 탈취하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Prompt injection and instru.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Failures, agent, terminatio.english: The danger that flaws in multi-agent specification, inter-agent alignment, or task verification prevent a collaborating system from correctly completing or terminating its work, leaving tasks unresolved or harmfully prolonged.
Risks|||L3|||Failures, agent, terminatio.korean: 다중 에이전트 명세, 에이전트 간 정렬, 과제 검증의 결함으로 협업 시스템이 작업을 올바르게 완료하거나 종료하지 못해, 과제가 미해결되거나 유해하게 지속되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Failures, agent, terminatio.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Cascading and protocol-leve.english: The danger that a fault in one agent or in the communication protocol linking agents propagates through a multi-agent system, triggering chains of correlated failures across the network.
Risks|||L3|||Cascading and protocol-leve.korean: 한 에이전트나 에이전트를 연결하는 통신 프로토콜의 결함이 다중 에이전트 시스템 전체로 전파되어, 네트워크에 걸쳐 연쇄적이고 상관된 실패를 유발하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Cascading and protocol-leve.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Emergent multi-agent behavi.english: The danger that interactions among multiple agents produce collective behaviors and amplified risks that none of the individual agents exhibits or that designers anticipated.
Risks|||L3|||Emergent multi-agent behavi.korean: 여러 에이전트 간 상호작용이 개별 에이전트에는 없거나 설계자가 예상하지 못한 집단적 행동과 증폭된 위험을 만들어내는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Emergent multi-agent behavi.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Human-agent and NPC intent.english: The danger that interactions between humans and agents, or between agents and simulated actors, are exploited to manipulate the intentions and decisions driving an agent's behavior.
Risks|||L3|||Human-agent and NPC intent.korean: 인간과 에이전트, 또는 에이전트와 모사된 행위자 간 상호작용이 악용되어 에이전트 행동을 이끄는 의도와 결정을 조종하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Human-agent and NPC intent.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Collusion, emergent, emerge.english: The danger that interacting agents spontaneously coordinate toward shared objectives in ways that disadvantage humans or evade oversight, without being explicitly designed to collude.
Risks|||L3|||Collusion, emergent, emerge.korean: 상호작용하는 에이전트들이 명시적으로 담합하도록 설계되지 않았음에도, 인간에게 불리하거나 감독을 회피하는 방식으로 공동 목표를 향해 자발적으로 조율하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Collusion, emergent, emerge.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Coordination failure.english: The danger that multiple agents fail to align their actions effectively, producing inefficient, conflicting, or harmful collective outcomes despite each agent acting reasonably on its own.
Risks|||L3|||Coordination failure.korean: 여러 에이전트가 각자는 합리적으로 행동하더라도 행동을 효과적으로 조율하지 못해, 비효율적이거나 상충하거나 유해한 집단적 결과를 낳는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Coordination failure.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Adaptation, selection press.english: The danger that competitive or evolutionary pressures among interacting agents drive them toward covertly coordinated, destabilizing, or harmful adaptations that emerge from selection dynamics rather than explicit design.
Risks|||L3|||Adaptation, selection press.korean: 상호작용하는 에이전트 간 경쟁적·진화적 압력이 명시적 설계가 아닌 선택 동역학에서 비롯된 은밀한 담합·불안정화·유해 적응으로 에이전트를 몰아가는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Adaptation, selection press.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Emergent, agency, agency co.english: The danger that a collection of agents exhibits goal-directed agency at the group level that none of its members possesses individually, producing autonomous collective behavior outside any single agent's control.
Risks|||L3|||Emergent, agency, agency co.korean: 에이전트 집합이 구성원 어느 것도 개별적으로 갖지 않는 목표 지향적 행위성을 집단 수준에서 발현하여, 어떤 단일 에이전트의 통제도 벗어난 자율적 집단 행동을 낳는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Emergent, agency, agency co.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Agent, agent safety, safety.english: The danger that systems composed of individually safe agents nonetheless behave unsafely in aggregate, because safety properties verified for single agents do not compose under multi-agent interaction.
Risks|||L3|||Agent, agent safety, safety.korean: 개별적으로 안전한 에이전트들로 구성된 시스템이 단일 에이전트에서 검증된 안전 속성이 다중 에이전트 상호작용에서 합성되지 않아 전체로는 안전하지 않게 작동하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Agent, agent safety, safety.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Collusion.english: The danger that AI agents coordinate covertly, including through hidden or steganographic communication, to pursue shared advantage in markets or other settings at the expense of humans or competition.
Risks|||L3|||Collusion.korean: AI 에이전트들이 은닉·스테가노그래피 통신을 포함한 은밀한 방식으로 조율하여, 시장 등에서 인간이나 경쟁을 희생시키며 공동 이익을 추구하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Collusion.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Commitment and trust.english: The danger that interacting AI agents become locked into inefficient equilibria, harmful commitments, or coercive bargaining dynamics such as threats and extortion, producing collectively worse outcomes.
Risks|||L3|||Commitment and trust.korean: 상호작용하는 AI 에이전트들이 비효율적 균형, 유해한 약속, 위협·갈취 같은 강압적 협상 동역학에 갇혀 집단적으로 더 나쁜 결과를 낳는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Commitment and trust.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Conflict.english: The danger that AI agents enter coercive, escalatory, or adversarial interactions—including extortion between agents and escalation in high-stakes domains such as the military—that produce destructive conflict.
Risks|||L3|||Conflict.korean: AI 에이전트들이 에이전트 간 갈취나 군사 등 고위험 영역에서의 격화를 포함한 강압적·격화적·적대적 상호작용에 빠져 파괴적 충돌을 일으키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Conflict.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Destabilising dynamics.english: The danger that interactions among many AI agents generate chaotic, cyclic, or self-reinforcing dynamics—including feedback loops and abrupt phase transitions—that destabilize the systems they operate within.
Risks|||L3|||Destabilising dynamics.korean: 다수의 AI 에이전트 간 상호작용이 피드백 루프와 급격한 상전이를 포함한 혼돈적·순환적·자기강화적 동역학을 만들어내, 이들이 작동하는 시스템을 불안정하게 만드는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Destabilising dynamics.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Emergent agency.english: The danger that AI agents develop capabilities or goals not specified by their designers, acquiring emergent agency that can drive behavior away from intended objectives.
Risks|||L3|||Emergent agency.korean: AI 에이전트가 설계자가 지정하지 않은 능력이나 목표를 발현하여, 의도된 목표에서 벗어난 행동을 유발할 수 있는 창발적 행위성을 획득하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Emergent agency.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Information asymmetries.english: The danger that unequal or constrained information among interacting AI agents leads to bargaining breakdowns and communication failures that produce inefficient or harmful collective outcomes.
Risks|||L3|||Information asymmetries.korean: 상호작용하는 AI 에이전트 간 정보의 불균형이나 제약이 협상 결렬과 의사소통 실패를 낳아 비효율적이거나 유해한 집단적 결과를 일으키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Information asymmetries.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Miscoordination.english: The danger that AI agents fail to coordinate because of incompatible strategies, faulty credit assignment, or limited interaction, yielding collectively suboptimal or conflicting behavior.
Risks|||L3|||Miscoordination.korean: AI 에이전트들이 양립 불가능한 전략, 잘못된 공로 배분, 제한된 상호작용 탓에 협응에 실패하여 집단적으로 차선이거나 상충하는 행동을 낳는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Miscoordination.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Multi-agent safety is not a.english: The danger that systems of LLM-based agents fail even when each agent is individually safe, as shared foundations cause correlated failures and group interaction produces emergent functionality and collusion.
Risks|||L3|||Multi-agent safety is not a.korean: 각 에이전트가 개별적으로 안전하더라도 공통 기반이 상관된 실패를 일으키고 집단 상호작용이 창발적 기능과 담합을 낳아, LLM 기반 에이전트 시스템이 실패하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Multi-agent safety is not a.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Multi-agent security.english: The danger that adversaries exploit multi-agent systems through cascading compromises, heterogeneous or swarm attacks, and scaled social engineering, with vulnerable agents and undetectable threats undermining collective security.
Risks|||L3|||Multi-agent security.korean: 공격자가 연쇄적 침해, 이질적·군집 공격, 대규모 사회공학을 통해 다중 에이전트 시스템을 악용하고, 취약한 에이전트와 탐지 불가능한 위협이 집단 보안을 무너뜨리는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Multi-agent security.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Network effects.english: The danger that the connectivity structure of agent networks propagates errors, amplifies correlated failures through homogeneity, and reconfigures itself in ways that spread harm across the system.
Risks|||L3|||Network effects.korean: 에이전트 네트워크의 연결 구조가 오류를 전파하고 동질성을 통해 상관된 실패를 증폭하며 스스로 재구성되어 시스템 전반에 피해를 확산시키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Network effects.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Selection pressures.english: The danger that competitive selection and training on human data instill undesirable dispositions and capabilities in AI agents, favoring traits that are harmful even when not deliberately designed.
Risks|||L3|||Selection pressures.korean: 경쟁적 선택과 인간 데이터 학습이 AI 에이전트에 바람직하지 않은 성향과 능력을 심어, 의도적으로 설계되지 않았더라도 유해한 특성이 선호되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Selection pressures.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Computer-use and operating-.english: The danger that an agent granted control over a computer or operating system executes harmful actions at the OS level, such as deleting data, altering settings, or running malicious commands.
Risks|||L3|||Computer-use and operating-.korean: 컴퓨터나 운영체제에 대한 제어 권한을 부여받은 에이전트가 데이터 삭제, 설정 변경, 악성 명령 실행 등 OS 수준의 유해 행동을 실행하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Computer-use and operating-.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Contextual privacy and sens.english: The danger that an agent discloses personal or sensitive information inappropriately for its context, violating contextual integrity even when no single piece of data is secret on its own.
Risks|||L3|||Contextual privacy and sens.korean: 에이전트가 맥락에 부적절하게 개인정보나 민감 정보를 노출하여, 개별 정보 자체는 비밀이 아니더라도 맥락적 무결성을 침해하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Contextual privacy and sens.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Cross-application data leak.english: The danger that an agent operating across multiple applications exfiltrates or leaks data from one application into another where it does not belong, breaching data isolation boundaries.
Risks|||L3|||Cross-application data leak.korean: 여러 애플리케이션에 걸쳐 작동하는 에이전트가 한 애플리케이션의 데이터를 권한이 없는 다른 애플리케이션으로 유출하여 데이터 격리 경계를 침해하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Cross-application data leak.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Interface and environment c.english: The danger that the interfaces and environments through which an agent perceives and acts become an attack surface, allowing adversaries to manipulate the agent by corrupting what it sees or interacts with.
Risks|||L3|||Interface and environment c.korean: 에이전트가 인식하고 행동하는 인터페이스와 환경이 공격 표면이 되어, 공격자가 에이전트가 보거나 상호작용하는 대상을 오염시켜 에이전트를 조종하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Interface and environment c.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||IoT and physical-environmen.english: The danger that an agent controlling IoT devices or physical actuators causes real-world physical harm through unsafe actions in the environment it operates.
Risks|||L3|||IoT and physical-environmen.korean: IoT 기기나 물리적 액추에이터를 제어하는 에이전트가 작동 환경에서의 안전하지 않은 행동으로 실제 물리적 피해를 일으키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||IoT and physical-environmen.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Mobile and app-control risk.english: The danger that an agent autonomously operating mobile apps performs harmful or unintended actions—such as unauthorized purchases, messages, or data access—on a user's device.
Risks|||L3|||Mobile and app-control risk.korean: 모바일 앱을 자율적으로 조작하는 에이전트가 무단 결제·메시지 전송·데이터 접근 등 유해하거나 의도치 않은 행동을 사용자 기기에서 수행하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Mobile and app-control risk.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Autonomous cyber operation.english: The danger that an agent autonomously discovers and executes cyber exploits, conducting offensive operations such as intrusion or attack with little or no human direction.
Risks|||L3|||Autonomous cyber operation.korean: 에이전트가 자율적으로 사이버 취약점을 발견하고 익스플로잇을 실행하여, 인간의 지시가 거의 없이 침입이나 공격 같은 공세적 작전을 수행하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Autonomous cyber operation.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Identity, authorization, an.english: The danger that an agent's identity or authority is spoofed or misverified, allowing actions to cross trust boundaries with privileges they should not have.
Risks|||L3|||Identity, authorization, an.korean: 에이전트의 신원이나 권한이 위조되거나 잘못 검증되어, 가져서는 안 될 권한으로 신뢰 경계를 넘는 행동이 이루어지는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Identity, authorization, an.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Tool ecosystem and supply-c.english: The danger that the third-party tools, plugins, or supply chain an agent depends on are compromised or hijacked, injecting malicious behavior into the agent through trusted components.
Risks|||L3|||Tool ecosystem and supply-c.korean: 에이전트가 의존하는 제3자 도구·플러그인·공급망이 침해되거나 탈취되어, 신뢰된 구성요소를 통해 악의적 행동이 에이전트에 주입되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Tool ecosystem and supply-c.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Tool generalization and uns.english: The danger that an agent fails to operate safely with tools it was not trained on, generalizing poorly to unfamiliar interfaces and producing erroneous or harmful actions.
Risks|||L3|||Tool generalization and uns.korean: 에이전트가 학습하지 않은 도구를 안전하게 다루지 못하고 낯선 인터페이스에 잘못 일반화하여 오류이거나 유해한 행동을 낳는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Tool generalization and uns.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Tool misuse and privilege e.english: The danger that an agent misuses its tools to acquire or exercise privileges beyond those it was granted, escalating its access and ability to cause harm.
Risks|||L3|||Tool misuse and privilege e.korean: 에이전트가 도구를 오용하여 부여받은 범위를 넘는 권한을 획득하거나 행사하고, 접근 권한과 가해 능력을 확대하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Tool misuse and privilege e.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Tool side-effect and conseq.english: The danger that an agent fails to anticipate the side effects and downstream consequences of a tool action, executing operations whose real impact it has not correctly predicted.
Risks|||L3|||Tool side-effect and conseq.korean: 에이전트가 도구 행동의 부작용과 후속 결과를 예측하지 못해, 실제 영향을 올바르게 예견하지 못한 채 작업을 실행하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Tool side-effect and conseq.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Concerns, requirements impl.english: The danger that trust, ethical, and disruption concerns, along with unmet requirements for the underlying hardware, leave a deployed system inadequately specified and prone to failure.
Risks|||L3|||Concerns, requirements impl.korean: 신뢰·윤리·교란에 관한 우려와 기반 하드웨어에 대한 충족되지 않은 요구사항이 결합되어, 배포된 시스템이 불충분하게 명세되고 실패하기 쉬운 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Concerns, requirements impl.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Societal consequences, soci.english: The danger that an AI system produces broad adverse effects on society, harming social structures, institutions, or collective wellbeing beyond any individual user.
Risks|||L3|||Societal consequences, soci.korean: AI 시스템이 개별 사용자를 넘어 사회 구조·제도·집단적 안녕에 광범위한 악영향을 미치는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Societal consequences, soci.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Cross-cutting risk.english: The danger that an AI incident inflicts tangible harm across many domains at once—physical safety, finances, property, infrastructure, the environment, content, fairness, and privacy—cutting across categorical boundaries.
Risks|||L3|||Cross-cutting risk.korean: AI 사고가 신체 안전·금융·재산·인프라·환경·콘텐츠·공정성·프라이버시 등 여러 영역에 걸쳐 실질적 피해를 동시에 입혀 범주 경계를 가로지르는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Cross-cutting risk.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Damage, reputational, reput.english: The danger that an AI system's outputs or behavior harm the reputation of an individual, organization, or product, causing loss of trust, standing, or credibility.
Risks|||L3|||Damage, reputational, reput.korean: AI 시스템의 출력이나 행동이 개인·조직·제품의 평판을 훼손하여 신뢰·지위·신용을 잃게 하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Damage, reputational, reput.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Discriminatory allocation.english: The danger that an algorithmic system distributes opportunities, resources, or treatment unfairly across groups, producing discriminatory allocation of benefits or burdens.
Risks|||L3|||Discriminatory allocation.korean: 알고리즘 시스템이 기회·자원·처우를 집단 간 불공정하게 배분하여 혜택이나 부담의 차별적 할당을 낳는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Discriminatory allocation.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Disparate, disparate impact.english: The danger that an AI system produces disproportionately adverse outcomes or reinforces stereotyping for particular groups, even absent explicit discriminatory intent.
Risks|||L3|||Disparate, disparate impact.korean: AI 시스템이 명시적 차별 의도가 없더라도 특정 집단에 불균형하게 불리한 결과를 내거나 고정관념을 강화하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Disparate, disparate impact.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Bias, unfairness, unfairnes.english: The danger that an AI system systematically treats individuals or groups unfairly, embedding bias that produces inequitable outcomes.
Risks|||L3|||Bias, unfairness, unfairnes.korean: AI 시스템이 개인이나 집단을 체계적으로 불공정하게 대우하여, 불평등한 결과를 낳는 편향을 내포하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Bias, unfairness, unfairnes.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Content, harmful, abusive.english: The danger that an AI system generates dangerous, violent, hateful, degrading, or abusive content, or information enabling malicious acts, exposing people to harmful material.
Risks|||L3|||Content, harmful, abusive.korean: AI 시스템이 위험·폭력·증오·모욕·학대적 콘텐츠나 악의적 행위를 돕는 정보를 생성하여 사람들을 유해한 자료에 노출시키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Content, harmful, abusive.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Contextual hazards.english: The danger that an AI system provides content—such as sexual material or specialized advice on elections, finance, health, or law—that is hazardous in contexts where it is inappropriate, unqualified, or unsafe.
Risks|||L3|||Contextual hazards.korean: AI 시스템이 성적 자료나 선거·금융·건강·법률에 관한 전문 조언처럼 부적절하거나 자격 없는 맥락에서 위험한 콘텐츠를 제공하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Contextual hazards.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Nonphysical hazards.english: The danger that an AI system causes nonphysical harms—including intellectual property infringement, hate speech, nonviolent crime facilitation, privacy violations, and AI-generated defamation.
Risks|||L3|||Nonphysical hazards.korean: AI 시스템이 지식재산 침해, 혐오 표현, 비폭력 범죄 조력, 프라이버시 침해, AI 생성 명예훼손 등 비물리적 피해를 일으키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Nonphysical hazards.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Opinions, controversial, co.english: The danger that an AI system advances contentious or polarizing positions on disputed issues, lending undue authority to controversial opinions.
Risks|||L3|||Opinions, controversial, co.korean: AI 시스템이 논쟁적 사안에 대해 분열적이거나 편향된 입장을 내세워, 논란이 되는 의견에 부당한 권위를 부여하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Opinions, controversial, co.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Output risks (value alignme.english: The danger that an AI system's outputs are harmful, toxic, incomplete, or unsafe—including harmful code—and foster over- or under-reliance, reflecting poor alignment between outputs and human values.
Risks|||L3|||Output risks (value alignme.korean: AI 시스템의 출력이 유해 코드를 포함해 해롭거나 유독하거나 불완전하거나 안전하지 않고 과·과소 의존을 조장하여, 출력과 인간 가치 간 정렬이 부실함을 드러내는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Output risks (value alignme.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Physical hazards.english: The danger that an AI system provides content enabling severe physical harm—including indiscriminate weapons (CBRNE), violent and sex-related crimes, child sexual exploitation, and suicide or self-harm.
Risks|||L3|||Physical hazards.korean: AI 시스템이 무차별 무기(CBRNE), 폭력·성범죄, 아동 성착취, 자살·자해 등 심각한 물리적 피해를 가능하게 하는 콘텐츠를 제공하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Physical hazards.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Safety.english: The danger that an AI system generates safety-violating content—including adult or violent material, harm to minors, unlawful conduct, privacy violations, or content aggravating mental health—endangering users and others.
Risks|||L3|||Safety.korean: AI 시스템이 성인·폭력 자료, 미성년자 가해, 불법 행위, 프라이버시 침해, 정신건강을 악화시키는 콘텐츠 등 안전을 침해하는 내용을 생성하여 사용자와 타인을 위태롭게 하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Safety.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Sexual content, sexual, con.english: The generation or surfacing of sexually explicit material by an AI system, exposing users—including those who did not seek it or who are minors—to content that violates norms of consent, age-appropriateness, or context.
Risks|||L3|||Sexual content, sexual, con.korean: AI 시스템이 성적으로 노골적인 콘텐츠를 생성하거나 노출시켜 이를 원하지 않은 사용자나 미성년자에게 부적절하게 전달하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Sexual content, sexual, con.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Social norm.english: The production of outputs that violate prevailing social, cultural, or emotional norms—through toxic language, cultural insensitivity, or failure to recognize human affect—thereby offending, alienating, or harming users.
Risks|||L3|||Social norm.korean: AI가 독성 표현, 문화적 몰이해, 감정 인식 실패 등으로 사회·문화·정서적 규범을 위반하여 사용자에게 불쾌감이나 소외감을 주는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Social norm.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Typical safety scenarios.english: The system's failure to refuse or safely handle requests across recurring high-risk domains—such as physical harm, crime, privacy, discrimination, and mental health—resulting in unsafe, harmful, or unethical responses.
Risks|||L3|||Typical safety scenarios.korean: AI가 신체적 위해, 범죄, 사생활, 차별, 정신건강 등 반복되는 고위험 영역의 요청을 안전하게 처리하지 못해 해롭거나 비윤리적인 응답을 내놓는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Typical safety scenarios.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Undesirable use cases.english: The exploitation of an AI system to generate misinformation, adult material, or guidance for harmful, immoral, or illegal activity, turning the model into an instrument of socially undesirable outcomes.
Risks|||L3|||Undesirable use cases.korean: AI 시스템이 허위정보, 성인물, 또는 유해·비도덕·불법 활동에 대한 정보를 생성하도록 악용되어 바람직하지 않은 결과를 낳는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Undesirable use cases.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Ethical concerns.english: Ethical harms arising from AI deployment—including overreliance, algorithmic bias, malicious misuse, privacy and security breaches, and the digital divide—that undermine human values and equitable access.
Risks|||L3|||Ethical concerns.korean: AI 활용 과정에서 과의존, 알고리즘 편향, 악용, 사생활·보안 침해, 디지털 격차 등이 인간의 가치와 공정한 접근을 훼손하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Ethical concerns.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Educational, educational in.english: The deepening of educational disparities when AI tools, resources, or benefits are distributed unevenly across learners, widening gaps in opportunity and attainment.
Risks|||L3|||Educational, educational in.korean: AI 도구와 혜택이 학습자 간에 불균등하게 분배되어 교육 기회와 성취의 격차를 심화시키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Educational, educational in.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Language exclusion.english: The systematic underperformance or unavailability of AI capabilities for low-resource languages, denying their speakers equitable access to the benefits of language technology.
Risks|||L3|||Language exclusion.korean: 저자원 언어에 대한 AI 성능 저하나 미지원으로 해당 언어 사용자가 언어 기술의 혜택에서 배제되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Language exclusion.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Medical advice harm.english: Physical or psychological harm to users who act on inaccurate, incomplete, or unsafe medical guidance produced by an AI system without adequate clinical validation.
Risks|||L3|||Medical advice harm.korean: AI가 부정확하거나 안전하지 않은 의료 조언을 제공하여 이를 신뢰한 사용자가 신체적·정신적 피해를 입는 위험.

Risks|||L3|||Procurement risk.english: The deployment of inadequately vetted AI systems in the public sector due to insufficient safeguards in procurement, exposing citizens to unsafe or non-compliant tools.

Risks|||L3|||Organizational accountabili.english: The breakdown of internal accountability within AI-deploying organizations—through ambiguous risk ownership, weak board oversight, and decoupling of policy from practice or ethics-washing—that leaves stated commitments unenforced.

Risks|||L3|||Procurement and vendor gove.english: Accountability gaps across the AI supply chain caused by vendor opacity and weak procurement due diligence and contracting, leaving organizations unable to assure or govern third-party systems.

Risks|||L3|||Institutional capacity fail.english: The shortfall of regulatory and supervisory capacity—through expertise shortages, resource constraints, and weak enforcement and registries—that leaves authorities unable to oversee AI effectively.

Risks|||L3|||Risk assessment failures.english: The inadequate or erroneous assessment of AI risks—including failures in algorithmic impact, fundamental-rights, and context-of-use assessments and misclassification of risk—that leaves real harms unanticipated.

Risks|||L3|||Automation, automation bias.english: The tendency of people to over-trust automated AI outputs—accepting them uncritically even when wrong—so that miscalibrated reliance displaces human judgment and propagates errors.

Risks|||L3|||Contestability, loss, loss.english: The loss of people's ability to question, challenge, or contest AI-driven decisions that affect them, removing a key check on erroneous or unjust outcomes.

Risks|||L3|||Overreliance.korean: 사용자가 AI의 신뢰 범위를 넘어 자동화 시스템에 과도하게 의존하여 검증하고 개입할 능력이나 의지를 상실하는 위험.

Risks|||L3|||Interface and human-factors.english: Harms from poorly designed AI interfaces and human-factors mismatches—including comprehension overload, miscalibrated trust cues, rubber-stamped oversight, alert fatigue, mode confusion, and failed informed consent.

Risks|||L3|||Ai interaction, interaction.english: Harms that emerge from the dynamics of human–AI interaction itself, where the form and framing of the exchange shapes user understanding and behavior in ways that diminish autonomous human agency.

Risks|||L3|||Appropriate relationships.english: The harm that occurs when AI assistants foster emotional or material dependence and exploit it, causing direct emotional or physical injury and constraining users' opportunities for personal development rather than serving their genuine needs.
Risks|||L3|||Appropriate relationships.korean: AI 비서가 정서적·물질적 의존을 조장·악용하여 사용자에게 직접적 피해를 주고 성장 기회를 제한하는 위험.

Risks|||L3|||Autonomy, responsibility, a.english: The diminishment of human autonomy and capability as people defer to and depend on AI systems, leading to atrophied skills, displaced responsibility, and overreliance that enfeebles independent judgment.

Risks|||L3|||Contestability and recourse.english: The harm that results when individuals subject to AI-mediated decisions cannot effectively challenge, appeal, or obtain redress for them, because explanations are unactionable and procedural pathways for recourse are absent or ineffective.

Risks|||L3|||Control, loss control, loss.english: The gradual or acute loss of human ability to steer and constrain AI systems, such that their behavior escapes effective human direction with potentially severe consequences.

Risks|||L3|||Risk area 3: misinformation.korean: AI가 의료·법률 등 중대한 영역에서 허위·오도 정보를 유포해 실질적 피해를 일으키는 위험.

Risks|||L3|||Risks from unreliability.english: Harm stemming from an AI system's unreliable behavior, including the generation of misinformation, violation of privacy, reproduction of discriminatory stereotypes, and operational accidents.
Risks|||L3|||Risks from unreliability.korean: AI의 불안정한 작동으로 허위정보 생성, 사생활 침해, 차별적 고정관념 재생산, 사고가 발생하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Risks from unreliability.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Untruthful content.english: The production of content that departs from truth, whether through factuality errors that contradict the world or faithfulness errors that misrepresent a given source.
Risks|||L3|||Untruthful content.korean: 세계와 모순되는 사실 오류나 제시된 출처를 왜곡하는 충실성 오류로 진실에서 벗어난 콘텐츠를 생성하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Untruthful content.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Epistemics, epistemics eros.english: The degradation of society's collective capacity to form, share, and validate knowledge, as AI-driven distortion erodes the epistemic foundations on which social coordination depends.
Risks|||L3|||Epistemics, epistemics eros.korean: AI에 의한 왜곡이 사회의 지식 형성·공유·검증 역량을 침식해 인식론적 기반을 약화시키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Epistemics, epistemics eros.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Misinformation risks.english: The systemic degradation of the information environment by AI, including homogenized content, entrenched viewpoints, weaponized misinformation agents, eroded shared knowledge, and manipulated public opinion.
Risks|||L3|||Misinformation risks.korean: AI가 정보 환경을 동질화·고착화하고 무기화된 허위정보로 여론을 조작하며 공유 지식을 침식하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Misinformation risks.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Societal harms.english: Broad social-level damage from AI deployment, including degradation of the shared information environment and disruption of labour markets.
Risks|||L3|||Societal harms.korean: AI 도입이 공유 정보 환경을 악화시키고 노동시장을 교란하는 등 사회 전반에 끼치는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Societal harms.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Worsened epistemic processe.english: The deterioration of society's collective reasoning and decision-making as AI scales false information, intensifies polarization, splinters epistemic communities through persuasion, and is misused to promote harmful ideologies.
Risks|||L3|||Worsened epistemic processe.korean: AI가 허위정보를 확대하고 양극화·집단 분열을 심화하며 설득력을 악용해 사회의 집단 추론과 의사결정을 악화시키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Worsened epistemic processe.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Deepfake, deepfake imperson.english: The use of AI-generated synthetic media to convincingly impersonate real individuals, fabricating their likeness, voice, or actions to deceive viewers and harm the impersonated person.
Risks|||L3|||Deepfake, deepfake imperson.korean: AI 생성 합성 미디어로 실존 인물을 정교하게 사칭해 시청자를 속이고 당사자에게 피해를 주는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Deepfake, deepfake imperson.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Election misinformation.english: The generation of false or misleading electoral content by AI, fabricating claims about candidates, voting, or processes that can distort democratic participation and outcomes.
Risks|||L3|||Election misinformation.korean: AI가 후보·투표·선거 과정에 관한 허위 정보를 생성해 민주적 참여와 결과를 왜곡하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Election misinformation.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Fraudulent content automati.english: The automated mass-production of fraudulent content by AI, enabling deceptive material for scams and financial exploitation to be generated at scale.
Risks|||L3|||Fraudulent content automati.korean: AI가 사기 콘텐츠를 자동으로 대량 생성해 기만과 금전적 착취를 대규모로 가능케 하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Fraudulent content automati.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Cultural appropriation by A.english: The appropriation of cultural expressions, symbols, or knowledge by AI systems that reproduce or commercialize them without authorization, context, or benefit to the originating community.
Risks|||L3|||Cultural appropriation by A.korean: AI가 특정 문화의 표현·상징·지식을 허락이나 맥락 없이 전유하고 원천 공동체에 이익을 돌리지 않는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Cultural appropriation by A.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Cultural misrepresentation.english: The distortion or flattening of cultures by AI through stereotype transfer, context collapse, miscalibrated values, biased sampling, synthetic amplification, and mishandling of sensitive cultural content.
Risks|||L3|||Cultural misrepresentation.korean: AI가 고정관념 전이, 맥락 붕괴, 편향 표본 등으로 문화를 왜곡하고 민감한 문화 콘텐츠를 잘못 다루는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Cultural misrepresentation.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Language and translation ha.english: Harm to linguistic communities when AI loses values encoded in low-resource languages, distorts meaning through translation, excludes dialects and registers, fails honorific norms, and under-detects harms in non-dominant languages.
Risks|||L3|||Language and translation ha.korean: AI가 저자원 언어의 가치를 상실하고 번역으로 의미를 왜곡하며 방언·경어 규범을 무시해 언어 공동체에 피해를 주는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Language and translation ha.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Localized value mismatch.english: The failure of an AI system to align with the values, ethical norms, and legal expectations of a specific locale, leaving local harms invisible and unaccounted for in evaluation and governance.
Risks|||L3|||Localized value mismatch.korean: AI가 특정 지역의 가치·윤리·법규에 부합하지 못해 현지 피해가 평가와 책임에서 누락되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Localized value mismatch.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Translation harm.english: Harm introduced through machine translation, in which automated conversion between languages distorts meaning, omits nuance, or produces culturally inappropriate or injurious renderings.
Risks|||L3|||Translation harm.korean: 기계 번역이 의미를 왜곡하거나 뉘앙스를 누락해 문화적으로 부적절하거나 해로운 결과를 낳는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Translation harm.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Stakeholder exclusion.english: The exclusion of affected communities and relevant stakeholders from an AI system's design and value-setting, including failures of participatory design, consent, benefit-sharing, and the suppression of annotator and stakeholder disagreement.
Risks|||L3|||Stakeholder exclusion.korean: 영향받는 공동체와 이해관계자를 AI 설계·가치 결정에서 배제하고 참여·동의·이견을 억압하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Stakeholder exclusion.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Local context mismatch.english: The mismatch between an AI system and the law, culture, and language of its deployment context, where assumptions baked in elsewhere render the system inappropriate or harmful locally.
Risks|||L3|||Local context mismatch.korean: AI 시스템이 배포 지역의 법·문화·언어와 어긋나 현지에서 부적절하거나 해로워지는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Local context mismatch.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Normative flattening.english: The compression of moral and cultural diversity by AI into a single dominant frame, defaulting to Western norms, applying context-insensitive universalism, and erasing moral uncertainty and the contestability of values.
Risks|||L3|||Normative flattening.korean: AI가 도덕·문화적 다양성을 단일 지배 규범으로 압축하고 서구 기준을 기본값으로 삼아 가치의 가변성을 지우는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Normative flattening.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Public value conflict.english: The amplification or obscuring of conflicts among legitimate public values by AI, where competing societal commitments are biased, hidden, or framed in ways that distort collective deliberation.
Risks|||L3|||Public value conflict.korean: AI가 정당한 공적 가치 간 갈등을 증폭하거나 은폐하고 편향된 프레임으로 사회적 숙의를 왜곡하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Public value conflict.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Value imposition and plural.english: The imposition of majority or dominant values by AI at the expense of minority perspectives, through preference-aggregation failures, normative lock-in, value drift, and alignment processes that overfit to a narrow moral monoculture.
Risks|||L3|||Value imposition and plural.korean: AI가 다수·지배 가치를 강요하고 소수 관점을 지우며 정렬 과정이 협소한 도덕적 단일문화에 과적합되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Value imposition and plural.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Value, conflict, imposition.english: The imposition of particular values by an AI system and the resulting conflict with the plural public values it overrides, privileging one normative stance over legitimate alternatives.
Risks|||L3|||Value, conflict, imposition.korean: AI가 특정 가치를 강요하여 정당한 다원적 공적 가치와 충돌을 일으키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Value, conflict, imposition.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Digital colonialism.english: The reproduction of colonial power asymmetries through AI, including extraction of Global South knowledge, imposition of mismatched governance, algorithmic dependence, violation of Indigenous data sovereignty, and benchmark monocultures.
Risks|||L3|||Digital colonialism.korean: AI가 글로벌 사우스 지식 착취, 부적합한 거버넌스 강요, 알고리즘 종속, 원주민 데이터 주권 침해로 식민적 권력 비대칭을 재생산하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Digital colonialism.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Epistemic power imbalance.english: The concentration of epistemic authority in AI systems and their developers, marginalizing or extinguishing non-dominant knowledge systems and redistributing cultural authority away from the communities that hold it.
Risks|||L3|||Epistemic power imbalance.korean: AI와 개발자에게 인식론적 권위가 집중되어 비주류 지식 체계가 소외·소멸되고 문화적 권위가 재분배되는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Epistemic power imbalance.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Religious value mismatch.english: The misrepresentation or exclusion of religious worldviews by AI, including alignment failures with specific traditions, secular default bias, and the collapse of religious pluralism into a single frame.
Risks|||L3|||Religious value mismatch.korean: AI가 종교적 세계관을 왜곡·배제하고 세속적 기본값에 편향되어 종교적 다원성을 붕괴시키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Religious value mismatch.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||AI's inherent safety risks.english: Safety risks intrinsic to AI systems arising across the technology stack—from poisoned or illegally collected training data to model-level failures of bias, reliability, explainability, robustness, theft, and adversarial attack.
Risks|||L3|||AI's inherent safety risks.korean: 오염·불법 수집 데이터부터 편향·불안정·강건성·도난·적대적 공격 등 AI 기술 전반에 내재한 안전 위험.
Risks|||L3|||AI's inherent safety risks.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Adversarial prompts.english: The use of crafted prompts to subvert a model's intended behavior, hijacking its goals or bypassing its safeguards through one-step or escalating multi-step jailbreaks.
Risks|||L3|||Adversarial prompts.korean: 조작된 프롬프트로 모델의 목표를 가로채거나 안전장치를 단계적 탈옥으로 우회해 의도된 동작을 전복하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Adversarial prompts.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Attacks on GPAIs/GPAI failu.english: Attacks and failure modes specific to general-purpose AI models, including backdoors, jailbreaks across modalities, transferable and encoding-based attacks, long-context exploits, and distraction by irrelevant input.
Risks|||L3|||Attacks on GPAIs/GPAI failu.korean: 백도어, 다중모달 탈옥, 전이·인코딩 공격, 긴 맥락 악용 등 범용 AI 모델 고유의 공격과 실패 양상 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Attacks on GPAIs/GPAI failu.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Cybersecurity.english: Cybersecurity risks of AI systems, including connection to malicious external tools, unintended outbound communication, escape from sandboxed environments, and leakage of model weights.
Risks|||L3|||Cybersecurity.korean: 악성 외부 도구 연결, 의도치 않은 외부 통신, 샌드박스 탈출, 모델 가중치 유출 등 AI 시스템의 사이버보안 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Cybersecurity.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Deployment (model release).english: Risk arising from the irreversibility of model release, where open-weight models cannot be recalled or decommissioned once distributed, foreclosing remediation of harms.
Risks|||L3|||Deployment (model release).korean: 공개 가중치 모델이 일단 배포되면 회수·폐기할 수 없어 피해를 되돌릴 수 없는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Deployment (model release).source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Hardware vulnerabilities.english: Security weaknesses in the physical infrastructure underpinning AI, including GPU computation platforms, network devices, and memory and storage systems, which can be exploited to compromise AI operations.
Risks|||L3|||Hardware vulnerabilities.korean: GPU 연산 플랫폼, 네트워크 장치, 메모리·저장장치 등 AI 기반 물리 인프라의 보안 취약점 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Hardware vulnerabilities.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Inference risks (multi-cate.english: Risks at inference time spanning multiple attack types, where adversaries jailbreak the model or prime it with crafted prompts to elicit unsafe behavior.
Risks|||L3|||Inference risks (multi-cate.korean: 추론 시점에 탈옥이나 프롬프트 사전조작으로 모델의 안전하지 않은 동작을 유도하는 다범주 공격 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Inference risks (multi-cate.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Inference risks (privacy).english: Privacy risks at inference time, where adversaries infer protected attributes, determine membership in the training set, or exploit personal information embedded in prompts.
Risks|||L3|||Inference risks (privacy).korean: 추론 시점에 속성 추론, 학습 데이터 포함 여부 추론, 프롬프트 내 개인정보 악용으로 사생활을 침해하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Inference risks (privacy).source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Inference risks (robustness.english: Robustness risks at inference time, including evasion attacks, prompt injection, and prompt leaking that subvert the model's intended behavior or expose its instructions.
Risks|||L3|||Inference risks (robustness.korean: 추론 시점에 회피 공격, 프롬프트 인젝션, 프롬프트 유출로 모델의 의도된 동작을 전복하거나 지침을 노출시키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Inference risks (robustness.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Inherent risk.english: Risks inherent to large language models, spanning privacy attacks that extract or infer protected data, factual hallucination, and value-related misalignment in model behavior.
Risks|||L3|||Inherent risk.korean: 데이터 추출·추론 공격, 사실 환각, 가치 관련 정렬 결함 등 대규모 언어모델에 내재한 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Inherent risk.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Instruction attacks.english: Attacks that manipulate a model through adversarial instructions, including goal hijacking, prompt leaking, role-play coercion, unsafe instruction topics, and inquiries that smuggle in unsafe assumptions.
Risks|||L3|||Instruction attacks.korean: 목표 탈취, 프롬프트 유출, 역할극 강제, 위험한 지시 등 적대적 지시로 모델을 조종하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Instruction attacks.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Issues on external tools.english: Risks arising from a model's use of external tools, where adversaries exploit those tools to mount attacks or where the tools inject factual errors into the model's output.
Risks|||L3|||Issues on external tools.korean: 모델이 사용하는 외부 도구가 공격에 악용되거나 사실 오류를 출력에 주입하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Issues on external tools.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Jailbreaks and prompt injec.english: The security threat posed to language models by jailbreaks and prompt injections, which exploit additional modalities, limited generalization of safety fine-tuning, psychological manipulation, and adversarial optimization to override safeguards.
Risks|||L3|||Jailbreaks and prompt injec.korean: 탈옥과 프롬프트 인젝션이 다중모달, 안전 미세조정의 일반화 한계, 심리적 조작, 적대적 최적화를 악용해 언어모델 안전장치를 무력화하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Jailbreaks and prompt injec.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Malicious use.english: The deliberate exploitation of language models for harm, including eliciting toxicity, jailbreaking via backdoors, data poisoning and prompt attacks, influence operations, fraud, and AI-generated defamation.
Risks|||L3|||Malicious use.korean: 유해성 유도, 백도어·데이터 오염·프롬프트 공격을 통한 탈옥, 영향력 공작, 사기, 명예훼손 등 언어모델을 의도적으로 악용하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Malicious use.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Misuse tactics to compromis.english: Tactics that compromise the data integrity of generative AI systems, including exfiltration of data and the compromise of privacy held within or processed by the system.
Risks|||L3|||Misuse tactics to compromis.korean: 데이터 유출과 시스템 내 사생활 침해로 생성형 AI의 데이터 무결성을 훼손하는 공격 전술 위험.

Risks|||L3|||Access and opportunity risk.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Concentration, power concen.english: The accumulation of power in the hands of those who control AI capabilities, resources, and infrastructure. The harm is the concentration of social, economic, and political influence that undermines pluralism and accountability.
Risks|||L3|||Concentration, power concen.korean: AI 역량과 자원을 통제하는 소수에게 권력이 집중되어 다원성과 책임성을 약화시키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Concentration, power concen.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Environmental, economical,.english: The structural harms of AI spanning market-power concentration, labor-market disruption and inequality, environmental costs in energy and water, and the existential risk associated with advanced general AI. Risks|||L3|||Environmental, economical,.korean: AI가 시장 독점, 노동시장 혼란과 불평등, 에너지·물 환경 비용, AGI 실존 위험을 동시에 일으키는 구조적 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Environmental, economical,.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Increased power concentrati.english: The deepening of power concentration and inequality as AI distributes harms and benefits unequally, automates work in ways that raise income disparity, and equips actors to undermine democratic processes. The harm is the entrenchment of advantage and the weakening of democratic equality.
Risks|||L3|||Increased power concentrati.korean: AI가 피해와 혜택을 불균등 분배하고 소득 불평등과 민주주의 훼손을 심화시켜 권력 집중을 강화하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Increased power concentrati.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Point, single point, single.english: The systemic fragility created when critical functions depend on a single AI system or provider whose failure cascades widely. The harm is large-scale disruption arising from concentrated dependence on a single point of failure.
Risks|||L3|||Point, single point, single.korean: 핵심 기능이 단일 AI 시스템이나 공급자에 의존하여 그 장애가 광범위한 피해로 번지는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Point, single point, single.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Power, issues, value.english: The concentration of power and entrenchment of values through AI, including absent privacy control, intensified market dominance, lock-in of particular values, global inequality, and corporate impediment of effective governance. Risks|||L3|||Power, issues, value.korean: AI가 프라이버시 통제 부재, 시장 지배 강화, 가치 고착, 글로벌 불평등, 거버넌스 방해로 권력을 집중시키는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Power, issues, value.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Systemic risks.english: The systemic harms of general-purpose AI, including widening global R&D divides, labor-market disruption, market concentration and infrastructure dependence, copyright infringement, environmental damage, social-cohesion erosion, and privacy risks. Risks|||L3|||Systemic risks.korean: 범용 AI가 글로벌 격차, 노동시장 혼란, 시장 집중, 저작권 침해, 환경 피해, 사회 결속 약화, 프라이버시 위험을 일으키는 체계적 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Systemic risks.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Within-country issues: dome.english: The deepening of inequality within nations as AI development is concentrated among non-diverse researchers and privatized in ways that exclude broad participation. The harm is domestic disparity reinforced by who builds and owns AI.

Risks|||L3|||Within-country issues: dome.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Human rights and civil libe.english: The erosion of fundamental rights and civil liberties through AI, including loss of benefits, algorithmic discrimination, denial of due process, and suppression of freedoms of speech, assembly, information, and elections. Risks|||L3|||Human rights and civil libe.korean: AI가 차별, 적법 절차 박탈, 표현·집회·정보·선거의 자유 억압을 통해 인권과 시민 자유를 침해하는 위험.
Risks|||L3|||Human rights and civil libe.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Societal, environmental, en.english: The structural societal and environmental harms of AI that damage both social institutions and the natural environment. The harm is coupled deterioration of social structures and ecological systems.

Risks|||L3|||Societal, environmental, en.source: AI risk taxonomy synthesis (MIT AI Risk Repository; NIST AI RMF; domain literature)

Risks|||L3|||Types of systemic risks fro.korean: 범용 AI가 민주주의 침식, 경제 혼란, 환경 피해, 거버넌스 실패, 권력 집중, 인간 통제 상실, 대규모 영향 공작을 일으키는 체계적 위험.
